'''Bastine Almadar''' was one a powerful noble in the [[Free Years]].

==History==
In c. {{fy|1096}}, forces led by Lady Bastine Almadar, Lord [[Jalaam Lazari]], and Lord [[Ahran Nawaz]] took the city of [[Bandar Eban]] and declared a nation that would become Arad Doman, and would ally themselves to an informal council of merchants, which would become formalized during the end of the [[War of the Hundred Years]].
